facts.fact: Farmerline says its five-year MoU of 12 June 2024 with the Ministry of Communication, Technology and Innovation commits it to develop language and speech models (speech recognition, text-to-speech) for Sierra Leone's agricultural sector, and it claims a first-of-its-kind Krio language model.

systems.system: Krio language model, Darli AI and Krio AI Agronomist
